library_preparation_preflight.summary: spring-modulith-apt is a javac annotation processor (processes "*", Javadoc-to-JSON at compile time); its own and its shaded aptk-tooling classes only run inside javac and are unreachable from a native image. The only runtime-usable surface is plain classes (TypeMetadata, MethodMetadata records; BuildSystemUtils, which auto-detects Gradle output without configuration) shipped in the same jar. Its only compile-scope deps (jspecify, spring-boot) resolve transitively via the normal testImplementation dependency. This mirrors the existing querydsl-apt/sundr-adapter-apt pattern in this repo, which needed no extra setup either.
risks: Because the processor and its aptk-tooling classes execute exclusively inside javac (never inside the built native image), meaningful reachability coverage is inherently thin — expect the shipped metadata to cover only the plain runtime classes (TypeMetadata, MethodMetadata, BuildSystemUtils), same as querydsl-apt's metadata. A thin metadata file here is expected, not a sign of incomplete test generation.
